name: Gusty offshore
notes: Wind model #10: 14-20 kn, oscillation +/-12 deg over 90-120 s, no persistent trend; frequent, strong puffs with wide fanning, and deep lulls.
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage and drift as fractions.

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's wobble: wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. Strength is fixed for the race (#10), so there is no strength-channel tuning.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning: the 1.5 deg wobble (#10 says only smaller and faster; about 1/8 of the amplitude keeps the peak shift within 1.2 x the amplitude), and the puff columns, set from #10's words (frequent, strong, wide fanning, deep lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, fan up to 8 deg, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
